texts: In the late summer of Year 1, two days before the autumn equinox, the Council questioned Coraline Ash at the Watch.
The questioning lasted for one afternoon.
Old Vesh said that the village lacked an apprentice candidate from a Keeper family that year.
The Council accepted Coraline Ash as an apprentice by a vote.
The Council assigned the apprentice Coraline Ash to Pell.

q1_issues.issue: "Old Vesh" is a wholly capitalized run, and the casing cue is stated as mechanical (a capitalized modifier joins the name, as in "Upper Calderwick"), so the symbol should be old_vesh; vesh applies the kinship/courtesy-title exception to a word that is neither a kinship nor a courtesy title.

q2_gaps: a season-of-a-stated-year temporal frame ("in the late summer of Year 1"): the Time terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus day-part constants, and seasons appear only as speech-anchored deictics (last_spring / next_summer), so "late summer" has no carrier and is dropped

a predicative "as"-phrase designating a role or status ("accepted Coraline Ash as an apprentice"): Resultatives & secondary predicates covers result states and depictives but never the as-complement, so the Result-vs-plain-concurrent-state choice is undecided

a duration whose unit is a day-part ("lasted for one afternoon"): (Measure e duration 1 afternoon) is shape-legal but afternoon is not a duration unit in the seeded canonical-second lexicon, so the duration is unqueryable across units
review.notes: The sealed say-complement is handled correctly throughout: indefinite witnesses stay inside the seal, the definite village typing and both compound-genus atoms project, and "that year" propagates the (Year 1) term. BeforeBy on the bare event-noun anchor, the Holder/Theme split on lack, and the past-wrapped Measure for Pell's age all match the instruction set.

issues.reason: Names and casing fixes the name as exactly its capitalized run and requires "one opaque symbol built from the whole name", and the carve-out that derives the symbol from the bare name is limited to a kinship or courtesy title ("Dr Okoro", "Uncle Bertrand"), which the capitalized epithet "Old" is not — so the licensed symbol is old_vesh.

gaps_confirmed: a non-deictic season frame over a stated year ("in the late summer of Year 1"): Time's structured terms stop at Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute and seasons exist only as speech-anchored deictic constants, so "late summer" has no carrier

a predicative "as"-phrase naming a role or status ("accepted Coraline Ash as an apprentice"): Resultatives covers result states and depictives but never the as-complement, so Result vs plain concurrent state is undecided

a duration whose unit is a day-part ("lasted for one afternoon"): (Measure e duration 1 afternoon) is shape-legal but "afternoon" sits outside the seeded canonical-second lexicon, so the duration cannot be compared or thresholded across units
new_gaps: a capitalized common noun premodifying a common-noun head ("a Keeper family"): the Northgate-spokesman rule routes a proper-noun premodifier to opaque Possession and the "the Assembly" rule covers a capitalized noun used as a referent's own label, but nothing decides a capitalized status/role word used as a classifier — fusing to keeper_family vs (Member sk_family_1 family) + (Possession sk_family_1 keeper) + (Name keeper "Keeper") is left open
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form is (: vesh_name (Name old_vesh "Old Vesh") (STV 1.0 0.99)) with old_vesh filling the say event's Experiencer slot, since the whole capitalized run is the name and the title carve-out reaches only kinship and courtesy titles.
adjudication.notes: The confirmed issue is symbol formation only — no atom is false, ill-typed or over-asserted, and the sealed say-complement (indefinites kept inside, definite village typing and both compound genera projected, "that year" propagated as (Year 1)), the BeforeBy anchor on the equinox event-noun, the Holder/Theme split on lack and the past-wrapped age Measure all match the instruction set. The dropped "late summer" frame and the Result state for "as an apprentice" are gap territory with true atoms, not defects.
